DitherLineChart.categories: The label of every point on the x axis.
DitherLineChart.series: The lines, each { label, color, values, low, high, dashed }.
DitherLineChart.zero: Start the value axis at zero. By default it fits the data.
DitherLineChart.smooth: A smooth curve that never overshoots, or straight segments.
DitherLineChart.axes: Show the value labels and the category labels.
DitherLineChart.tooltip: Show the readout while the pointer moves over the chart.
DitherLineChart.legend: Show the legend. Hover a key to spotlight a series, click to lock it.
DitherLineChart.interactive: The readout and the legend spotlight.
DitherLineChart.animated: The lines are drawn in from the left when the chart appears.
DitherLineChart.unit: Written after every value, such as %. Values are shortened to 1.2K.
DitherLineChart.level: Coverage of the range bands, 0 to 1.
DitherLineChart.matrix: The dither pattern of the bands.
DitherLineChart.cell: Size of one dither cell in the bands.
DitherLineChart.chart-height: Height of the chart, axes included.
